Selling Tracked Cars at Pay 'n' Spray (Chapter 3) — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Pay 'n' Spray locations across Leonida

Once the story moves on, the spray shops start buying the cars Moses wouldn't touch.

Full guide — contains spoilers

From early Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray buys stolen cars, and the no-tracker rule disappears: a Standard Tracker car typically brings ~$2,500 or more in perfect condition, up to $4,000+ for a good car. Sales are limited to 3 cars per day. The offer is shown before you accept, and repairing damage first helps because dents, bullet holes and burst tyres cut the price. games.gg counts 19 Pay 'n' Sprays across the five counties, shown as an orange spray can on the map.

Source & evidence

Source: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter — GameMapa (built on PowerPyx's money guide) (2026-11-18).

Evidence: Chapter-by-chapter money guide read in full; figures attributed to PowerPyx.. Honest range is $2,500–$4,000+ per car: PowerPyx's 100% guide gives ~$2,500+ in perfect condition as the typical figure; the '$4,000+' phrasing comes from GameMapa's summary. It is a per-car sale rate, not a story-job payout. 3 cars/day limit per gta.guide.
